description: Source code for VirtualInput plugin handling input events, key mappings, and IPC communication in a media framework.

classes.name: InputEvent
classes.description: Helper class to format input event data into strings for logging.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Main class managing input events, key mappings, and IPC communication.

classes.name: LinuxKeyboardInput
classes.description: Linux-specific implementation of VirtualInput using uinput.

classes.name: IPCUserInput
classes.description: IPC-based implementation of VirtualInput for remote input handling.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports key mappings from JSON array into internal key map.

methods.name: Export
methods.description: Exports internal key map to JSON array.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for input events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for input events.

methods.name: SendModifier
methods.description: Manages modifier key state and triggers.

methods.name: ModifierKey
methods.description: Sends modifier key events based on current state.

methods.name: DispatchRegisteredKey
methods.description: Dispatches key events to registered notifiers and manages repeat logic.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Updates device key states based on change iterator.

methods.name: MapChanges
methods.description: Maps key changes to virtual device.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends input events (key, mouse, touch) to the system or IPC.
